2608.04569.title: Relevant but Incomplete: Referential Dangling as a Paradigm-Level Failure Mode in Hard Prompt Compression
2608.04569.paper_summary: Hard prompt compression reduces long-context inference cost by independently scoring tokens, sentences, or chunks and retaining the highest-scoring units under a budget. We identify a structural failure in this procedure: independent selection can split dependent evidence pairs, retaining one member while deleting the other. When retained text contains an answer but deleted text defines the entity needed to interpret it, we call the result referential dangling. At a compression ratio of 0.30, Beaver, which ranks coherent chunks using Qwen3-0.6B embeddings, leaves the answer path incomplete in 34-54% of bridge examples across three multi-hop question answering datasets. On a shared HotpotQA bridge set, all six hard compressors we test exhibit dangling at rates up to 60%, and every document in LongBench-v2 Single-Document QA contains at least one dangling reference. On dangling examples evaluated with Qwen3-8B, reinserting the missing supporting paragraph while removing nonsupporting paragraphs to maintain the token budget improves accuracy by 29-34 percentage points (p < 0.0001), recovering at least 88% of the gap to contexts retaining both supporting paragraphs. Stronger answer models do not absorb the loss: on MuSiQue, GPT-5.5 is 8.8 points less accurate on compressed contexts than on contexts retaining both supporting paragraphs. Finally, we train a compact classifier to rank omitted sentences by whether they are needed to interpret retained text and reinsert the top-ranked candidates without support annotations at inference. On HotpotQA with Qwen3-8B, this automatic restoration improves accuracy by 4.7 points while changing the compression ratio only from 0.30 to 0.31. Hard compressors should optimize both relevance and referential completeness.
2608.04569.paper_summary_zh: 硬提示壓縮通過獨立評分標記、句子或片段，並在預算內保留得分最高的單元，來降低長上下文推理的成本。 我們在這個過程中識別出一個結構性失敗：獨立選擇可能會拆分依賴證據對，保留一個成員而刪除另一個。 當保留的文本包含答案但刪除的文本定義了解釋該答案所需的實體時，我們稱這種結果為參考懸空。 在0.30的壓縮比下，Beaver使用Qwen3-0.6B嵌入對連貫片段進行排名，在三個多跳問題回答數據集中，34-54%的橋接示例中留下了不完整的答案路徑。 在共享的HotpotQA橋接集上，我們測試的六個硬壓縮器在高達60%的比率上顯示出懸空情況，而LongBench-v2單文件QA中的每個文檔至少包含一個懸空參考。在使用Qwen3-8B評估的懸空示例中，重新插入缺失的支持段落，同時刪除不支持的段落以維持標記預算，將準確率提高了29-34個百分點（p < 0.0001），恢復了至少88%的差距，以便於保留兩個支持段落的上下文。 更強的答案模型並未吸收這一損失：在MuSiQue上，GPT-5.5在壓縮上下文中的準確率比在保留兩個支持段落的上下文中低8.8個點。 最後，我們訓練了一個緊湊的分類器，根據省略句子是否需要解釋保留文本來對其進行排名，並在推理時重新插入排名最高的候選者而不帶支持註釋。 在使用Qwen3-8B的HotpotQA上，這一自動恢復將準確率提高了4.7個點，壓縮比僅從0.30變為0.31。 硬壓縮器應該優化相關性和參考完整性。
